protocol.title: The Call of the Wild
protocol.author: Jack London
protocol.selection_reason: Preselected official NarrativeQA test book, compatible public-domain literature; no questions inspected before this declaration
protocol.retrieval: Frozen MiniLM BM25 hybrid + MS-MARCO reranking; four passages per question; no gold answer injected into passages

prompts.direct: Use only the supplied passages. Answer the question concisely. If the passages do not support an answer, abstain. Return JSON only with keys answer (string), abstain (boolean), citations (list of passage labels such as P1), supporting_quotes (list of objects with citation and quote). Every nonempty answer must cite at least one provided passage and include an exact supporting quote from that passage. Do not use outside knowledge.
prompts.strict: You are an evidence-bound literary reader. First check whether the retrieved passages explicitly support the requested fact. Similar themes, familiar character names and your prior knowledge are insufficient. If evidence is incomplete, set abstain=true and answer="". Otherwise answer in at most 15 words. Output only valid JSON: {"answer":"...","abstain":false,"citations":["P1"],"supporting_quotes":[{"citation":"P1","quote":"an exact substring of P1"}]}. Use only labels present below. Quotes must support the answer. Never guess.
